author: zicokolter
text: I'm excited to announce that I am joining the OpenAI Board of Directors. I'm looking forward to sharing my perspectives and expertise on AI safety and robustness to help guide the amazing work being done at OpenAI.

quoted.text: Zico Kolter from Carnegie Mellon joins OpenAI’s Board, bringing technical and AI safety expertise; he also joins the Safety & Security Committee. https://t.co/ABpEqcXkoV
